articles.title_en: Macro level matters: Advancing circular economy in different business systems within Europe
articles.title_cn: 宏观层面的重要性：在欧洲不同的商业体系中推进循环经济
articles.abstract_en: Extant research on the circular economy has explored intra- and inter-firm dynamics, activities and drivers, whilst macro level factors — systemic features of the national economy — have been somewhat neglected. In this conceptual article, we use the lens of national business system (NBS) theory to explore how different components and configurations of such systems encourage — or hinder — the adoption of the circular economy. We use three European examples (France, Germany and the United Kingdom) to illustrate our argumentation. Our analysis suggests that the development and implementation of circular economy measures necessitate an encompassing consideration of the NBS in which they are embedded. By foregrounding macro level phenomena, we contribute to a more comprehensive understanding of circular systems and offer a sound foundation for more effective policymaking.
articles.abstract_cn: 现有关于循环经济的研究探讨了企业内和企业间的动态、活动和驱动因素，而宏观层面的因素——国家经济的系统性特征——则在某种程度上被忽视了。在这篇概念性文章中，我们运用国家商业体系（NBS）理论的视角，探讨这些体系的不同组成部分和配置如何鼓励或阻碍循环经济的采用。我们使用三个欧洲案例（法国、德国和英国）来阐述我们的论点。我们的分析表明，循环经济措施的发展和实施需要对其所嵌入的国家商业体系进行全面考量。通过突出宏观层面的现象，我们有助于更全面地理解循环系统，并为更有效的政策制定提供坚实的基础。

articles.title_en: Environmental change and ecosystem functioning drive transitions in social-ecological systems: A stylized modelling approach
articles.title_cn: 环境变化与生态系统功能驱动社会-生态系统转型：一种风格化建模方法
articles.abstract_en: Sustainable management of social-ecological systems requires an understanding of how anthropogenic climate- and land use change may disrupt interactions between human societies and the ecosystem processes they depend on. In this study, we expand an existing stylized social-ecological system model by explicitly considering how urbanizing societies may become less dependent on local ecosystem functioning. This expansion is motivated by a previously developed conceptual framework suggesting that societies may reside in either a green loop and be strongly dependent on local ecosystem processes, or in a red loop where this dependency is weaker due to imports of natural resources from elsewhere. Analyzing the feasibility and stability of local social-ecological system states over a wide range of environmental and socio-economic conditions, we observed dynamics consistent with the notion of green loop-dominated and red loop-dominated societies comprising alternate stable social-ecological states. Based on systems' inherent dependencies on local ecosystem processes, responses to environmental change could comprise either transitions between green loop- and red loop-dominated states, or collapse of either of these states. Our quantitative model provides an internally consistent mapping of green loop- and red loop-dominated states, as well as transitions between or collapses of these states, along a gradient of environmental conditions.
articles.abstract_cn: 社会-生态系统的可持续管理需要理解人为气候变化和土地利用变化如何可能破坏人类社会与其所依赖的生态系统过程之间的相互作用。在本研究中，我们通过明确考虑城市化社会可能减少对当地生态系统功能的依赖，扩展了一个现有的风格化社会-生态系统模型。这一扩展的动机来自于先前开发的一个概念框架，该框架提出社会可能处于绿色循环中，强烈依赖当地生态系统过程，或者处于红色循环中，由于从其他地方进口自然资源，这种依赖较弱。通过分析在广泛的环境和社会经济条件下当地社会-生态系统状态的可行性和稳定性，我们观察到了与绿色循环主导和红色循环主导社会构成交替稳定社会-生态状态的概念一致的动态。基于系统对当地生态系统过程的固有依赖，对环境变化的响应可能包括绿色循环主导和红色循环主导状态之间的转变，或者这些状态中的任何一种崩溃。我们的定量模型提供了绿色循环主导和红色循环主导状态以及这些状态之间转变或崩溃的沿环境条件梯度的内部一致映射。

articles.title_en: How do nature governance rules affect compliance decisions? An experimental analysis
articles.title_cn: 自然治理规则如何影响合规决策？一项实验分析
articles.abstract_en: In an age of unprecedented decline in global biodiversity levels, the task of designing laws that effectively protect nature and biodiversity is urgent. To help address this enforcement deficit, European policymakers have sought to democratise environmental enforcement by conferring citizens and environmental nongovernmental organisations (NGOs) with legal rights of access to environmental information, public participation and access to justice in environmental matters, derived from an international treaty known as the UNECE Aarhus Convention (the so-called “Aarhus mechanisms”). However, there has been little systematic empirical research to date on the effectiveness of this new wave of private nature governance laws, and their impacts on compliance decisions. This paper seeks to address this gap. We investigate, by means of a laboratory experiment with student participants, the extent to which different nature governance rules affect individuals' decisions to comply. By nature governance rules, we mean the legal tools used to promote compliance with nature conservation rules, including traditional governance rules such as criminal penalties and civil fines, but also the new generation of private governance rules, in the form of the Aarhus mechanisms. Our findings provide new empirical experimental confirmation that traditional and private environmental governance rules together achieve more effective nature conservation outcomes than traditional governance rules alone. They also suggest, however, that private governance rules may lead to some duplication of enforcement effort by the State and citizens.
articles.abstract_cn: 在全球生物多样性水平空前下降的时代，设计有效保护自然和生物多样性的法律任务十分紧迫。为帮助解决这一执法赤字，欧洲政策制定者试图通过赋予公民和环境非政府组织（NGOs）获取环境信息、公众参与和环境事务司法救济的法律权利，来民主化环境执法，这些权利源自一项名为联合国欧洲经济委员会《奥胡斯公约》的国际条约（即所谓的“奥胡斯机制”）。然而，迄今为止，关于这一新一波私人自然治理法律的有效性及其对合规决策影响的系统性实证研究很少。本文旨在填补这一空白。我们通过一项以学生参与者为对象的实验室实验，研究不同自然治理规则在多大程度上影响个人的合规决策。我们所说的自然治理规则，是指用于促进遵守自然保护规则的法律工具，包括传统治理规则如刑事处罚和民事罚款，也包括新一代私人治理规则，即奥胡斯机制形式。我们的研究结果提供了新的实证实验确认，传统和私人环境治理规则相结合比仅靠传统治理规则能实现更有效的自然保护成果。然而，它们也表明，私人治理规则可能导致国家和公民的执法努力出现某种重复。

articles.title_en: Rethinking Economic Practices and Values As Assemblages of More-Than-Human Relations
articles.title_cn: 重新思考经济实践与价值：作为超越人类关系聚合体的存在
articles.abstract_en: The relational turn in the academic literature on environmental values explores ontologies that rethink the dualistic, hierarchical separations of humans from nature. In particular, the consideration of a plurality of values and ways in which humans connect to nature has brought new insights on the dynamic interconnections between people, place and environmental processes, all highly relevant for the world's sustainability challenges. However, many conceptualizations of economic practices and values are still predominantly dualistic and anthropocentric. To overcome this human-nature divide we propose a conceptual integration of relational values with assemblages of more-than-human relations, illustrated with examples from the literature and ongoing empirical research. These concepts offer a way of representing meaningful and dynamic interrelationships, including humans, physical elements, materials (e.g. technologies, tools), immaterial entities (e.g. sounds, lights, colors), and other non-human beings. We argue that such conceptual integration provides a useful framework to rethink diverse economies as the processes through which humans and non-humans co-constitute their interrelated livelihoods. With this, we extend the relational turn to research on economic human-nature connections, following the call of many scholars in the field of ecological economics to unveil non-utilitarian values and consider multiple economic agencies.
articles.abstract_cn: 环境价值学术文献中的关系转向探索了本体论，这些本体论重新思考了人类与自然的二元对立、等级化分离。特别是，对多元价值以及人类与自然连接方式的考量，为人们、地方与环境过程之间的动态互联带来了新的见解，这些都与世界的可持续性挑战高度相关。然而，许多经济实践和价值的概念化仍然主要是二元论和人类中心主义的。为了克服这种人与自然的鸿沟，我们提出将关系价值与超越人类关系的聚合体进行概念整合，并用文献和正在进行的实证研究中的例子加以说明。这些概念提供了一种表征有意义且动态相互关系的方式，包括人类、物理元素、材料（如技术、工具）、非物质实体（如声音、光线、颜色）以及其他非人类存在。我们认为，这种概念整合为重新思考多样化经济提供了有用的框架，将其视为人类与非人类共同构成其相互关联生计的过程。借此，我们将关系转向扩展到经济人与自然联系的研究中，响应生态经济学领域许多学者的呼吁，揭示非功利主义价值并考虑多重经济能动性。

articles.title_en: Ethical underpinnings for the economy of the Anthropocene: Sustainability ethics as key to a sustainable economy
articles.title_cn: 人类世经济的伦理基础：可持续性伦理作为可持续经济的关键
articles.abstract_en: This conceptual paper emphasizes the need for considering ethical aspects in developing a sustainable economy that meets the challenges of the historic overuse of the planet in the Anthropocene. The paper argues that a sustainable economy is, at its core, an ethical challenge and requires a new ethical underpinning which considers the ethical dimension of sustainability and insights from sustainability ethics. The tradition of Western economic thought, and specifically the modern conception of the capitalist market economy, are based on rather narrow ethical foundations which are not sufficient to support a sustainable economy. Traditional economic conceptions have mostly focused on the wellbeing of current individuals and societies. There have been no broader systematic economic conceptions that fully integrate the wellbeing of nature, other species, and future beings. A sustainable economy requires a significantly expanded and redefined ethical underpinning that integrates two aspects: First, a broader ethical foundation that systematically considers nature, non-human beings, future beings, and people around the world. Second, a re-definition of individual wellbeing and societal welfare beyond rational utility maximization, efficiency, and growth.
articles.abstract_cn: 这篇概念性论文强调，在发展中考虑伦理方面的必要性，以应对人类世中地球历史性过度使用的挑战，从而建立可持续经济。论文认为，可持续经济本质上是一个伦理挑战，需要新的伦理基础，该基础需考虑可持续性的伦理维度以及可持续性伦理的见解。西方经济思想传统，特别是现代资本主义市场经济的观念，基于相当狭隘的伦理基础，不足以支持可持续经济。传统经济观念大多关注当前个人和社会的福祉。没有更广泛的系统性经济观念能够完全整合自然、其他物种和未来存在的福祉。可持续经济需要显著扩展和重新定义的伦理基础，该基础整合两个方面：第一，更广泛的伦理基础，系统性地考虑自然、非人类存在、未来存在以及世界各地的人们。第二，重新定义个人福祉和社会福利，超越理性的效用最大化、效率和增长。

articles.title_en: Self-image and the stability of international environmental agreements
articles.title_cn: 自我形象与国际环境协议的稳定性
articles.abstract_en: In this paper we examine the stability of international environmental agreements about a (common) emissions target. By signing the agreement, the parties develop a sense of responsibility to the commitment made, gaining a self-image that contributes to their utility.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们考察了关于（共同）排放目标的国际环境协议的稳定性。通过签署协议，各方对所作承诺产生责任感，获得一种有助于其效用的自我形象。

articles.title_en: Targeting socioeconomic transformations to achieve global sustainability
articles.title_cn: 瞄准社会经济转型以实现全球可持续性
articles.abstract_en: Green growth and post-growth are alternative concepts for transformative change. I investigated the amount of support each enjoys among sustainability scholars by performing a global expert survey (n = 461), in which scholars from around the world evaluated what future pathways they would prefer for different country income groups. Support for post-growth was substantial for high-income (77%) and upper-middle-income countries (59%) for the 2020s, while green growth was the most preferred pathway for lower-middle-income (64%) and low-income (58%) countries. Support for post-growth increased from 2020s to 2030s. On average, preferred future GDP rates were at or above 0% and at or below past average GDP rates regardless of context. I found an interaction between pathway preference and familiarity with post-growth, which helped explain desired future GDP rates in the context of high-income countries. Around 60% of the participants considered GDP to be a bad indicator of societal well-being. My results call for more emphasis on targeted transformational change in research, education, and policymaking, with particular focus on facilitating post-growth approaches for affluent countries. This could help societies find a safe and just way to secure global sustainability.
articles.abstract_cn: 绿色增长和后增长是变革性变革的替代概念。我通过进行一项全球专家调查（n = 461）调查了可持续发展学者中每个概念获得的支持程度，来自世界各地的学者评估了他们偏好不同国家收入组的未来路径。对于高收入国家（77%）和中高收入国家（59%），对后增长的支持在2020年是显著的，而绿色增长是低收入国家（64%）和低收入国家（58%）最偏好的路径。对后增长的支持从2020年到2030年有所增加。平均而言，偏好的未来GDP增长率在0%或以上，且不超过过去的平均GDP增长率，无论背景如何。我发现路径偏好与对后增长的熟悉度之间存在交互作用，这有助于解释高收入国家背景下期望的未来GDP增长率。大约60%的参与者认为GDP是社会福祉的不良指标。我的研究结果呼吁在研究、教育和政策制定中更加重视有针对性的转型变革，特别关注促进富裕国家的后增长方法。这可能有助于社会找到一条安全且公正的途径来确保全球可持续性。

articles.title_en: Factors influencing the realisation of the social impact of urban nature in inner-city environments: A systematic review of complex evidence
articles.title_cn: 影响内城环境中城市自然社会效益实现的因素：复杂证据的系统综述
articles.abstract_en: The beneficial health, wellbeing and liveability impacts of urban nature are broadly evidenced and increasingly engaged with in planning and policy. But anomalies in empirical evidence suggest that benefits do not flow equally to all. This review paper analyses the contribution of existing research on how the material and social context and subjective factors shape the social impact of urban nature. We review 46 international papers published between 2019 and 2021 that present findings from inner-city metropolitan contexts. The findings evidence variations in benefits and some dis-benefits derived from urban nature associated with features of the material context (e.g., urban and greenspace form, infrastructure and facilities), the social context (e.g., demographic diversity and socio-economic standing) and subjective factors such as gender and cultural identity. We recommend an inclusive research and planning approach that is attuned to the role of the human experience in the realisation of the social impact of urban nature to ensure that the prevalent urban greening agenda actually benefits all city dwellers and does not unintentionally contribute to further inequality. We recommend a shift of focus from ‘physical access to nature’ to ‘actually realised access to its benefits’ for more inclusive policy and planning.
articles.abstract_cn: 城市自然对健康、福祉和宜居性的有益影响已被广泛证实，并在规划和政策中日益受到重视。但实证证据中的异常现象表明，这些益处并非均等地惠及所有人。本综述分析了现有研究如何探讨物质和社会背景以及主观因素如何塑造城市自然的社会影响。我们回顾了2019年至2021年间发表的46篇国际论文，这些论文呈现了内城大都市背景下的研究结果。研究结果显示了城市自然带来的益处和某些不利影响的变化，这些变化与物质背景特征（如城市和绿地形态、基础设施和设施）、社会背景特征（如人口多样性和社会经济地位）以及主观因素（如性别和文化认同）相关。我们建议采取包容性的研究和规划方法，关注人类体验在实现城市自然社会影响中的作用，以确保普遍的城市绿化议程真正惠及所有城市居民，并不会无意中加剧进一步的不平等。我们建议将焦点从“物理上接触自然”转向“实际实现其益处的获取”，以实现更具包容性的政策和规划。

articles.title_en: Genetically engineered varieties and applied pesticide toxicity in U.S. maize and soybeans: Heterogeneous and evolving impacts
articles.title_cn: 转基因品种与美国玉米和大豆的农药施用毒性：异质性与演变影响
articles.abstract_en: The extensive adoption of genetically engineered (GE) varieties in U.S. agriculture has dramatically changed the patterns of pesticide use. How this process ultimately affects environmental risk remains an open question. Previous studies have typically relied on aggregate trends to infer the impact of GE crop adoption on pesticide use, which fails to address selection bias and unobserved heterogeneity. We overcome this limitation by analyzing applied pesticide toxicity using farm-level fixed effects models, estimated with rich plot-level data on >200,000 seed and pesticide choices by U.S. maize and soybean farmers during the 1998–2016 period. We find that applied toxicity was, on average, lowered by the adoption of GE varieties across four target organism groups: mammals, birds, fish, and honey bees. However, most of the toxicity benefits conferred by GE adoption dissipated over time. For herbicide tolerant varieties, this was due to the increased use of old-line herbicides by GE adopters, a likely consequence of the growing problem of glyphosate weed resistance. Applied honey bee toxicity saw the sharpest increase during the GE era, but most of this increase was driven by the adoption of neonicotinoid seed treatments, rather than GE insect resistant traits.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国农业中转基因（GE）品种的广泛采用已极大地改变了农药使用的模式。这一过程最终如何影响环境风险仍是一个悬而未决的问题。以往的研究通常依赖总体趋势来推断转基因作物采用对农药使用的影响，这未能解决选择偏差和未观测异质性问题。我们通过使用农场层面的固定效应模型分析施用农药毒性，克服了这一局限，该模型基于1998-2016年期间美国玉米和大豆农民超过200,000个种子和农药选择的丰富地块级数据估计。我们发现，总体上，转基因品种的采用降低了针对四类目标生物群（哺乳动物、鸟类、鱼类和蜜蜂）的施用毒性。然而，转基因采用所带来的大部分毒性效益随时间消散。对于耐除草剂品种，这是由于转基因采用者增加了对老式除草剂的使用，这可能是草甘膦杂草抗性日益严重的结果。在转基因时代，施用蜜蜂毒性增幅最大，但这一增长主要是由新烟碱类种子处理的采用驱动的，而非转基因抗虫性状。

articles.title_en: The risks of the wrong climate policy for developing countries: Scenarios for South Africa
articles.title_cn: 错误气候政策对发展中国家的风险：南非情景分析
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, a demand-driven growth model is used to explore climate change scenarios faced by the South African economy. The focus is on key macroeconomic variables including employment, productivity, income distribution, trade, and fiscal balances. Results show that emission reduction alone will not put South Africa on a sustainable and equitable growth path. Expansionary macroeconomic policies are necessary. We show that, under sufficient global mitigation, expansionary fiscal and monetary policies lead to faster output and productivity growth, higher employment, and lower inequality. By contrast, macroeconomic tightening or “free riding” on global emission reduction lead to inferior outcomes, putting sustainable development out of reach.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文采用需求驱动增长模型，探讨南非经济面临的气候变化情景。重点关注关键宏观经济变量，包括就业、生产率、收入分配、贸易和财政平衡。结果表明，仅靠减排不会使南非走上可持续和公平的增长道路。扩张性宏观经济政策是必要的。我们表明，在全球充分减缓气候变化的情况下，扩张性财政和货币政策将带来更快的产出和生产率增长、更高的就业率和更低的 inequality。相比之下，宏观经济紧缩或对全球减排“搭便车”会导致较差的结果，使可持续发展遥不可及。

articles.title_en: Optimal R&D investment in the management of invasive species
articles.title_cn: 入侵物种管理中的最优研发投资
articles.abstract_en: Invasive alien species (IAS) threaten world biodiversity, ecosystem services, and economic welfare. While existing literature has characterized the optimal control of an established IAS, it has not considered how research and development (R&D) into new removal methods or technologies can affect management decisions and costs over time. R&D can lower the costs of control in a management plan and creates an intertemporal trade-off between quick but costly control and gradual but cheaper removal over time. In this paper, we develop and solve a continuous time dynamic optimization model to study how investment in R&D influences the optimal control of an established invasive species. After characterizing the dynamic model solution, we solve the model numerically to study the benefits from R&D in the management of the brown tree snake (Boiga irregularis), and explore how optimal solutions vary across economic and biological conditions. We find that the introduction of R&D significantly reduces overall costs of IAS and management and that the cost reductions substantially outweigh research expenditure. These results imply that policymakers seeking to control IAS should consider R&D as a vital component of cost effective control strategies.
articles.abstract_cn: 外来入侵物种（IAS）威胁着世界生物多样性、生态系统服务和经济福利。虽然现有文献已经描述了已建立入侵物种的最优控制，但尚未考虑针对新清除方法或技术的研发（R&D）如何随时间影响管理决策和成本。研发可以降低管理计划中的控制成本，并在快速但昂贵的控制与逐步但更便宜的清除之间产生跨期权衡。在本文中，我们开发并求解了一个连续时间动态优化模型，以研究研发投资如何影响已建立入侵物种的最优控制。在刻画动态模型解之后，我们数值求解该模型，以研究研发在棕树蛇（Boiga irregularis）管理中的收益，并探讨最优解如何随经济和生物条件变化。我们发现，引入研发显著降低了入侵物种和管理的总成本，且成本降低大幅超过研究支出。这些结果表明，寻求控制入侵物种的政策制定者应将研发视为成本有效控制策略的重要组成部分。

articles.title_en: Can contract farming support sustainable intensification in agri-food value chains?
articles.title_cn: 合同农业能否支持农业食品价值链中的可持续集约化？
articles.abstract_en: Sustainable intensification aims to minimize the negative impacts of the current agricultural system while maintaining productivity and economic outputs. This study demonstrates that contract farming is a potential mechanism to support many, but not all, farmers in adopting sustainable intensification practices. A discrete choice experiment on a hypothetical value chain contract introducing three sustainable intensification practices, namely extended crop rotation, reducing agrochemicals and planting flower strips, was conducted with a sample of 314 north-Italian wheat farmers. The results show that permanently eliminating glyphosate from the plot under contract is strongly resisted by farmers, while farmers have less strong preferences between introducing legumes or oilseeds in rotation, and between temporary or permanent flower strips. Findings also indicate that farmers who are more educated, are not members of cooperatives and who generally prefer more flexible sales arrangements are unlikely to be triggered to adopt sustainable intensification practices through contract farming. Overall, this study indicates that while voluntary contract arrangements can be a potential tool to increase uptake of sustainable intensification practices, they will likely need to be complemented with more public policy intervention in order to bring sustainable intensification practices to scale.
articles.abstract_cn: 可持续集约化旨在最小化当前农业系统的负面影响，同时保持生产力和经济产出。本研究表明，合同农业是支持许多（但并非所有）农民采用可持续集约化实践的潜在机制。一项针对假设价值链合同的离散选择实验引入了三种可持续集约化实践，即延长作物轮作、减少农用化学品和种植花卉带，样本为314名意大利北部小麦种植户。结果显示，农民强烈抵制在合同地块上永久性消除草甘膦，而农民在轮作中引入豆科植物或油料作物之间，以及在临时或永久花卉带之间的偏好差异较小。研究结果还表明，受教育程度较高、非合作社成员以及通常偏好更灵活销售安排的农民，不太可能通过合同农业被触发采用可持续集约化实践。总体而言，本研究表明，虽然自愿合同安排可以成为提高可持续集约化实践采用率的潜在工具，但可能需要辅以更多的公共政策干预，才能将可持续集约化实践推广到更大规模。

articles.title_en: Tropical mixed-species plantations can outperform monocultures in terms of carbon sequestration and economic return
articles.title_cn: 热带混交人工林在碳固存和经济回报方面可优于单一栽培
articles.abstract_en: Tropical reforestation is an important strategy to mitigate the global climate crisis through the sequestration of CO2. Together with increasing CO2 prices, carbon storage becomes increasingly relevant for commercial reforestations. Due to higher productivity, mixed-species reforestations have been suggested for carbon plantings. Yet, current studies comparing mixtures and monocultures lack an in-depth comparison of economic and carbon sequestration potentials. Moreover, their economic valuations do not consider carbon payments and differences in forest management. Using a simulation-optimization approach, we compared the economic and carbon sequestration performance of commercial mixed-species stands and monocultures in Costa Rica. Mixed-species stands outperformed their monoculture peers by net present value (NPV) up to 3135 USD/ha if only timber sales were considered, or 3500–16,800 USD/ha if carbon payments were also considered (at a discount rate of 8%). When managed solely for carbon sequestration, the best-performing mixture achieved a mean stand carbon 7% above the best-performing monoculture. The results were sensitive to the comparison baseline applied. The results of this study suggest that tropical mixed-species plantations can be a competitive alternative to monocultures. Forest investors could benefit from establishing mixed-species plantations when reforesting plantation sites where species-specific site suitability is uncertain, or when working with lesser-studied tree species.
articles.abstract_cn: 热带再造林是通过固存CO2来缓解全球气候危机的重要策略。随着CO2价格的上涨，碳储存对商业再造林变得越来越重要。由于更高的生产力，混交再造林已被建议用于碳种植。然而，目前比较混交林和单一栽培的研究缺乏对经济潜力和碳固存潜力的深入比较。此外，其经济评估未考虑碳支付和森林管理的差异。采用模拟优化方法，我们比较了哥斯达黎加商业混交林分和单一栽培的经济和碳固存表现。如果仅考虑木材销售，混交林分的净现值（NPV）比单一栽培高出最多3135美元/公顷，如果同时考虑碳支付（贴现率为8%），则高出3500-16,800美元/公顷。当仅以碳固存为管理目标时，表现最佳的混交林的平均林分碳比表现最佳的单一栽培高7%。结果对应用的比较基线敏感。本研究结果表明，热带混交人工林可以成为单一栽培的有竞争力的替代方案。在树种适宜性不确定或使用研究较少的树种时，森林投资者在再造林地点建立混交人工林可能受益。

articles.title_en: Assessing the impact of waste separation on system transition and environmental performance through a city-scale life cycle assessment
articles.title_cn: 通过城市尺度生命周期评估评估垃圾分类对系统转型和环境绩效的影响
articles.abstract_en: The increase in municipal solid waste (MSW) generation entails growing pressures on developing countries to achieve urban sustainability. New waste management strategies should be implemented with caution considering limited budget and uncertain outcome. Taking the city of Shenzhen, China as a case study, this research aimed to assess the positive transition of this city's MSW management system since the recent enforcement of waste separation. The life cycle assessment (LCA) results confirmed a good synergy between waste management system upgrade and environmental performance improvements. A noteworthy reduction of 51% in Global Warming Potential (GWP) was observed with determined cost of 61 US$/t CO2-eq, making waste separation a cost-effective management option for developing economies to achieve their environmental targets. Sensitivity analysis was performed to address the effect of specific waste composition and related properties on systematic environmental performance. Results emphasized the impact of a certain waste treatment pathway is not always constant therefore characterization of local waste flow is vital to facilitate integrated waste management. Municipalities from developing countries are encouraged to take mandatory separation as a first step to upgrade insufficient waste management system before heavy investment in new treatment technologies.
articles.abstract_cn: 城市固体废物（MSW）产生量的增加给发展中国家实现城市可持续性带来了越来越大的压力。考虑到有限的预算和不确定的结果，应谨慎实施新的废物管理策略。以中国深圳市为例，本研究旨在评估自最近实施垃圾分类以来，该市MSW管理系统的积极转型。生命周期评估（LCA）结果证实了废物管理系统升级与环境绩效改善之间的良好协同作用。观察到全球变暖潜势（GWP）显著降低51%%，确定成本为61美元/吨CO2当量，使垃圾分类成为发展中经济体实现其环境目标的成本效益高的管理选项。进行了敏感性分析，以解决特定废物组成及相关性质对系统环境绩效的影响。结果强调，某一废物处理途径的影响并非总是恒定的，因此当地废物流的特征化对于促进综合废物管理至关重要。鼓励发展中国家的市政当局在大量投资于新的处理技术之前，将强制分类作为升级不足的废物管理系统的第一步。

articles.title_en: Climate change impacts on Mediterranean fisheries: A sensitivity and vulnerability analysis for main commercial species
articles.title_cn: 气候变化对地中海渔业的影响：主要商业物种的敏感性与脆弱性分析
articles.abstract_en: Climate-induced projected range shifts of exploited species would lead to a redistribution of stocks. Evaluating the combined ecological and socio-economic consequences of projected changes in Mediterranean fisheries due to climate change has remained largely unexplored. This study aims to identify the most affected stocks by climate change and more vulnerable countries in the region. Thus, we calculated the species specific sensitivity per country for 17 harvested species of significant importance. Then, we evaluated the vulnerability index for Mediterranean countries. Results show that temperate-cold species, i.e., Sprattus sprattus and Solea solea appear the most sensitive species. In contrast, temperate-warm species like the bogue showed the lowest sensitivity. Egypt, Tunisia, and Libya are the most vulnerable countries due to their comparatively high exposure to global warming and low adaptive capacity. At the same time, Slovenia, France, and Croatia have the lowest vulnerability because of their low exposure and sensitivity and remarkably high adaptive capacity. The southern Mediterranean countries would be the most vulnerable to climate-induced effects on marine fisheries. The region seriously needs adequate and adopted on-time adaptation and mitigation policies to lessen potential risks to harvested species and stocks and guarantee the contribution of fisheries to the economy and food security in the long-term.
articles.abstract_cn: 气候引起的开发物种预计范围变化将导致种群重新分布。评估气候变化对地中海渔业造成的预计变化的生态和社会经济综合后果在很大程度上仍未得到探索。本研究旨在识别受气候变化影响最严重的种群以及该地区更脆弱的国家。因此，我们计算了17个具有重要意义的捕捞物种在每个国家的物种特异性敏感性。然后，我们评估了地中海国家的脆弱性指数。结果表明，温带-冷水物种，即黍鲱和鳎鱼，似乎是最敏感的物种。相比之下，温带-暖水物种如博格鱼表现出最低的敏感性。埃及、突尼斯和利比亚是最脆弱的国家，因为它们对全球变暖的暴露相对较高，适应能力较低。同时，斯洛文尼亚、法国和克罗地亚的脆弱性最低，因为它们的暴露和敏感性低，适应能力显著高。南地中海国家将最容易受到气候引起的海洋渔业影响。该地区迫切需要充分且及时采取的适应和减缓政策，以减少对捕捞物种和种群的潜在风险，并确保渔业对经济和粮食安全的长期贡献。

articles.title_en: Climate change, international migration, and interstate conflicts
articles.title_cn: 气候变化、国际移民与国家间冲突
articles.abstract_en: Interstate conflicts are complex and often have a multitude of causes. These factors can be social, economic, or cultural. One social factor receiving little attention in the literature is international migration. This paper uses climate shocks as a driver of emigration to study the causal impact of immigration on conflicts. We find that climate-induced immigration increases the probability that the destination country initiates a conflict against the origin. This effect is moderated by attitudes in the receiving country and features of the specific flows. The results imply that countries severely impacted by climate change may face an exodus of migrants and be forced to confront conflicts initiated by the destination countries of these migrants.
articles.abstract_cn: 国家间冲突是复杂的，往往有多种原因。这些因素可以是社会的、经济的或文化的。文献中较少关注的一个社会因素是国际移民。本文利用气候冲击作为移民的驱动因素，研究移民对冲突的因果影响。我们发现，气候导致的移民增加了目的地国对来源国发起冲突的概率。这种效应受到接收国态度和特定移民流动特征的影响。结果表明，受气候变化严重影响的国家可能面临移民外流，并被迫应对这些移民目的地国发起的冲突。

articles.title_en: Community-based climate adaption: A perspective on the interface between a common pool resource system and an individual-based market transaction system
articles.title_cn: 社区型气候适应：公共池塘资源系统与个体市场交易系统之间的界面视角
articles.abstract_en: Because of land privatisation and marketisation in rural areas, community-based adaptation to climate change may face new challenges. A field survey conducted on the Qinghai–Tibetan Plateau (QTP) shows that herders with a grassland collective management system (CMS) suffer higher livestock mortality than those with an individual management system (IMS) during the same extreme climatic events, in contrast to previous research findings. This study seeks to explain this contrast. The results show that although local herders have begun to rely on market-related adaptation strategies to cope with climate change, IMS herders are more inclined to rent-in grassland, while CMS herders are more inclined to purchase fodder. The high-cost grassland renting-in strategy reduces livestock mortality and total household economic loss more effectively than purchasing fodder during snow disasters. An important reason for this is that IMS strengthens market concepts and promotes interaction between herders and external markets, especially the grassland rental market, while CMS continues past grazing traditions and maintains traditional social relationships and collective concepts within the community. CMS herders fail to rent-in grassland due to psychological free-riding incentives and scale mismatch. In the face of repeated climatic disasters, however, CMS herders have also begun to overcome various obstacles to entering the grassland rental market through self-organization and are gradually forming a new pathway of adaptation to climate change.
articles.abstract_cn: 由于农村地区土地私有化和市场化，基于社区的气候变化适应可能面临新的挑战。在青藏高原进行的一项实地调查显示，在相同的极端气候事件中，采用草地集体管理系统的牧民比采用个体管理系统的牧民遭受更高的牲畜死亡率，这与以往的研究结果相反。本研究旨在解释这一差异。结果表明，尽管当地牧民已开始依赖市场相关的适应策略来应对气候变化，但个体管理系统牧民更倾向于租入草地，而集体管理系统牧民更倾向于购买饲料。在雪灾期间，高成本的草地租入策略比购买饲料更有效地降低了牲畜死亡率和家庭总经济损失。一个重要原因是，个体管理系统强化了市场观念，促进了牧民与外部市场（尤其是草地租赁市场）的互动，而集体管理系统延续了过去的放牧传统，维持了社区内的传统社会关系和集体观念。集体管理系统牧民因心理上的搭便车激励和规模错配而未能租入草地。然而，面对反复的气候灾害，集体管理系统牧民也开始通过自组织克服进入草地租赁市场的各种障碍，并逐渐形成一种新的气候变化适应路径。

articles.title_en: Climate change, income sources, crop mix, and input use decisions: Evidence from Nigeria
articles.title_cn: 气候变化、收入来源、作物组合与投入品使用决策：来自尼日利亚的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper combines panel data from nationally representative household-level surveys in Nigeria with long-term satellite-based spatial data on temperature and precipitation using geo-referenced information related to households. It aims to quantify the impacts of climate change on agricultural productivity, income shares, crop mix, and input use decisions. We measure climate change in harmful degree days, growing degree days, and changes in precipitation using long-term (30 year) changes in temperature and precipitation anomalies during the crop calendars. We find that, controlling for other factors, a 15% (one standard deviation) increase in change in harmful degree days leads to a decrease in agricultural productivity of 5.22% on average. Similarly, precipitation change has resulted in a significant and negative impact on agricultural productivity. Our results further show that the change in harmful degree days decreases the income share from crops and nonfarm self-employment, while it increases the income share from livestock and wage employment. Examining possible transmission channels for this effect, we find that farmers change their crop mix and input use to respond to climate changes, for instance reducing fertilizer use and seed purchases as a response to increases in extreme heat. Based on our findings, we suggest policy interventions that incentivize adoption of climate-resilient agriculture, such as small-scale irrigation and livelihood diversification. We also propose targeted pro-poor interventions, such as low-cost financing options for improving smallholders' access to climate-proof agricultural inputs and technologies, and policy measures to reduce the inequality of access to livelihood capital such as land and other productive assets.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文结合尼日利亚全国代表性住户调查的面板数据，以及基于地理参照信息与住户相关的长期卫星空间温度和降水数据。旨在量化气候变化对农业生产力、收入份额、作物组合和投入品使用决策的影响。我们通过作物日历期间温度和降水异常的长期（30年）变化来衡量气候变化，包括有害度日、生长度日和降水变化。我们发现，在控制其他因素的情况下，有害度日变化增加15%（一个标准差）平均导致农业生产力下降5.22%。同样，降水变化对农业生产力产生了显著且负面的影响。我们的结果进一步表明，有害度日的变化降低了作物和非农自雇的收入份额，同时增加了牲畜和工资就业的收入份额。通过考察这一效应的可能传导渠道，我们发现农民改变作物组合和投入品使用以应对气候变化，例如减少化肥使用和种子购买以应对极端高温的增加。基于我们的发现，我们建议采取激励采用气候适应性农业的政策干预措施，如小规模灌溉和生计多样化。我们还提出有针对性的扶贫干预措施，如为改善小农户获得气候适应性农业投入品和技术的机会提供低成本融资选项，以及减少生计资本（如土地和其他生产性资产）获取不平等的政策措施。

articles.title_en: Understanding citizen investment in renewable energy communities
articles.title_cn: 理解公民对可再生能源社区的投资
articles.abstract_en: This research investigates factors driving citizen participation in renewable energy communities (RECs) using demographically representative surveys including a discrete choice experiment on attributes of RECs and a contingent valuation experiment on intended amounts of investment in RECs in France, Germany, and Poland. We investigate, in particular, whether municipalities can incentivize citizens to invest in RECs by offering to match their investments and examine the effect of small probabilities of losing the entire investment. Further, we analyze the role of preferences, capabilities, and social factors that have not or only scarcely been studied in the context of RECs. Our results provide evidence that matching by the municipality has a positive effect on citizen investment. Further, ruling out even small risks of losing the entire investment may substantially increase citizen participation in RECs. The experiments suggest that investments in RECs are related to willingness to take risks and willingness to take losses. Individual capabilities (i.e. financial literacy, experience), social norms, place identity, and trust in local government also seem to spur citizen investment in RECs.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究利用具有人口代表性的调查，包括对可再生能源社区（RECs）属性的离散选择实验和对法国、德国、波兰可再生能源社区预期投资金额的条件价值评估实验，探讨了驱动公民参与可再生能源社区的因素。我们特别研究了市政当局是否可以通过提供匹配投资来激励公民投资可再生能源社区，并考察了损失全部投资的微小概率的影响。此外，我们分析了在可再生能源社区背景下尚未或很少研究的偏好、能力和社会因素的作用。我们的结果提供了证据表明，市政当局的匹配对公民投资有积极影响。此外，排除即使很小的损失全部投资的风险也可能显著增加公民对可再生能源社区的参与。实验表明，对可再生能源社区的投资与风险承担意愿和损失承担意愿相关。个人能力（即金融素养、经验）、社会规范、地方认同和对地方政府的信任似乎也促进了公民对可再生能源社区的投资。

articles.title_en: Are greenspaces too green? Landscape preferences and water use in urban parks
articles.title_cn: 绿地是否过于绿色？城市公园的景观偏好与用水
articles.abstract_en: With climate change, it is becoming more challenging for water-limited cities to sustain historic watering levels in urban parks, leading park managers to consider changes to park designs. However, the extent to which people value parks that deviate from conventional designs featuring primarily irrigated lawn remains uncertain. We use a choice experiment to assess public preferences for different park designs in Perth, Australia. With a scale-adjusted latent class model, we identify optimal groundcover compositions for four preference classes. We find that while having some watered grass in urban parks is important, the public are also accepting of non-irrigated alternatives. Incorporating at least 40% native vegetation groundcover can both increase the utility the public derives from parks and conserve water. Park managers also have a high degree of flexibility in designing parks that vary from the optimal groundcover composition but that still deliver near-optimal benefits to communities.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着气候变化，水资源受限的城市维持城市公园历史灌溉水平变得越来越具有挑战性，导致公园管理者考虑改变公园设计。然而，人们对偏离以灌溉草坪为主的传统设计的公园的重视程度仍不确定。我们使用选择实验来评估澳大利亚珀斯对不同公园设计的公众偏好。通过尺度调整潜在类别模型，我们确定了四个偏好类别的最佳地被植物组成。我们发现，虽然城市公园中拥有一些灌溉草坪很重要，但公众也接受非灌溉替代方案。纳入至少40%的本土植被地被植物既可以增加公众从公园获得的效用，又可以节约用水。公园管理者在设计公园时也具有高度的灵活性，可以偏离最佳地被植物组成，但仍能为社区带来接近最优的效益。

articles.title_en: Macroeconomic impacts of water allocation under droughts. Accounting for global supply chains in a multiregional context
articles.title_cn: 干旱条件下水资源配置的宏观经济影响：多区域背景下考虑全球供应链
articles.abstract_en: Water allocation policies play a key role in determining the impact of drought events on the macroeconomic system. Economic agents may find it difficult to modify their production structure immediately, and will therefore try to maintain current production and commercial patterns. The study takes this behavior into account and combines a Multi-Regional Input-Output model with a Non-Linear Programming optimization model to assess the macroeconomic impacts of localized droughts on a global scale. It analyses their propagation through interconnected supply chains, and it also evaluates the implications of different water allocation policies in terms of GDP impacts, with a large regional and sectoral detail. Our results show that the policy-regime chosen greatly determines the extent of the economic impacts, both in the directly affected region and in third countries. When the drought affects only agriculture, that negative economic impacts can be mitigated by adjusting production and trade. In contrast, when water availability is reduced uniformly across all economic sectors in the drought-stricken region, economic losses spread across the globe.
articles.abstract_cn: 水资源配置政策在决定干旱事件对宏观经济系统的影响方面发挥着关键作用。经济主体可能难以立即调整其生产结构，因此将努力维持当前的生产和商业模式。本研究考虑了这种行为，并将多区域投入产出模型与非线性规划优化模型相结合，以评估局部干旱在全球范围内的宏观经济影响。它分析了这些影响通过相互关联的供应链的传播，并评估了不同水资源配置政策在GDP影响方面的含义，具有较大的区域和部门细节。我们的结果表明，所选择的政策体制在很大程度上决定了经济影响的程度，无论是在直接受影响的地区还是在第三国。当干旱仅影响农业时，负面经济影响可以通过调整生产和贸易来缓解。相反，当干旱地区所有经济部门的水资源可用性均匀减少时，经济损失会波及全球。

articles.title_en: Nature-based solutions for climate change mitigation: Assessing the Scottish Public's preferences for saltmarsh carbon storage
articles.title_cn: 基于自然的减缓气候变化解决方案：评估苏格兰公众对盐沼碳储存的偏好
articles.abstract_en: The saltmarsh carbon storage potential is a key topic in blue carbon research and climate policy. Ecosystem service valuations provide valuable information to policymakers for habitat management and climate change mitigation policies. Yet, only few saltmarsh valuation studies have included the carbon storage service in the UK context. This paper investigates how the public values saltmarsh ecosystem services, focussing on the carbon storage service. We used a choice experiment to elicit the willingness to pay (WTP) of a representative sample of the Scottish public to support interventions that would maintain or improve the provision of these services. Furthermore, we tested the effect of information on individuals' preferences and WTP with a split sample approach where one group received a treatment in the form of additional information. We found that (i) all attributes had a significant influence on individuals' choices; (ii) both groups had, on average, a positive marginal WTP for all presented ecosystem services; (iii) the treated sample had, on average, no significantly different marginal WTP for carbon storage than the control group. This paper adds to the limited literature on the saltmarsh carbon storage ecosystem service and demonstrates a developed nation's public's openness to nature-based climate change mitigation solutions.
articles.abstract_cn: 盐沼碳储存潜力是蓝碳研究和气候政策中的一个关键主题。生态系统服务价值评估为政策制定者提供了有关栖息地管理和减缓气候变化政策的有价值信息。然而，在英国背景下，只有少数盐沼价值评估研究包含了碳储存服务。本文调查了公众如何评价盐沼生态系统服务，重点关注碳储存服务。我们使用选择实验来引出苏格兰公众代表性样本的支付意愿（WTP），以支持维持或改善这些服务提供的干预措施。此外，我们通过分裂样本方法测试了信息对个人偏好和支付意愿的影响，其中一组接受了额外信息形式的处理。我们发现：（i）所有属性对个人的选择都有显著影响；（ii）两组平均对所有呈现的生态系统服务都有正的边际支付意愿；（iii）处理组平均对碳储存的边际支付意愿与对照组没有显著差异。本文补充了关于盐沼碳储存生态系统服务的有限文献，并展示了一个发达国家公众对基于自然的减缓气候变化解决方案的开放性。

articles.title_en: Mediation and moderation roles of resilience capacity in the shock–food-security nexus in northern Ghana
articles.title_cn: 加纳北部冲击-粮食安全关系中韧性能力的中介与调节作用
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines how resilience capacity mediates or moderates the relationship between weather shocks and household food security based on two waves of farm household survey and satellite-based weather data in northern Ghana and applying econometric models. Results show that resilience capacity moderate or mediates the negative effects of heat stress and drought on food security. However, the mediating role of resilience capacity in the shock-food security nexus is more stable and stronger than its moderating role. A standard deviation (SD) increase in heat stress reduces household food consumption by 0.71 SD, but resilience capacity effectively moderates this effect by approximately 0.61 SD. For drought, household food consumption is reduced by 0.67 SD, but resilience capacity effectively dampens this negative effect by approximately 0.60 SD. The mediation results, on the other hand, indicate that 537% of the total effect of heat stress on household calorie consumption is explained by the indirect effect through resilience capacity. Similarly, resilience capacity mediates about 74% of the total effect of heat stress on household food consumption. These results suggest that strategies that help improve resilience capacity, such as the adoption of sustainable intensification practices, are critical in enhancing food security in northern Ghana.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文基于加纳北部两轮农户调查和卫星天气数据，运用计量经济模型，考察了韧性能力如何中介或调节天气冲击与农户粮食安全之间的关系。结果表明，韧性能力能够调节或中介热应激和干旱对粮食安全的负面影响。然而，韧性能力在冲击-粮食安全关系中的中介作用比其调节作用更为稳定和强烈。热应激每增加一个标准差（SD），农户粮食消费减少0.71个标准差，但韧性能力能有效调节这一影响，约减少0.61个标准差。对于干旱，农户粮食消费减少0.67个标准差，但韧性能力能有效缓冲这一负面影响，约减少0.60个标准差。另一方面，中介结果表明，热应激对农户卡路里消费的总效应中，有537%是通过韧性能力的间接效应解释的。同样，韧性能力中介了热应激对农户粮食消费总效应的约74%。这些结果表明，有助于提高韧性能力的策略，如采用可持续集约化实践，对于增强加纳北部的粮食安全至关重要。
